name: flow_esc_menu_offline
description: There is a way out of a match (design 5.1, 5.4): in an offline match Esc with nothing placed or selected opens a small plate on the console's panel, Resume, Restart and Leave to hub, and the match waits while it is up; Esc again resumes. Esc while placing a tower only stops the placing, and Esc (or a right click) with a creep selected only drops the selection; the next Esc opens the menu. Restart plays the same match from its start; Leave to hub goes back to the hub, offline.

steps.msg: Esc while placing only stops the placing

steps.assert: node('MatchMenu').visible and node('MatchMenu').choices() == ['Resume', 'Restart', 'Leave to hub'] and node('MenuTitle').text == 'Paused'
steps.msg: with nothing to cancel, Esc opens the menu: Resume, Restart, Leave to hub
the offline match waits while the menu is up
no order goes out behind the plate

steps.assert: scene_path() == 'res://scenes/main.tscn' and Session.match_spec.has('offline') and not node('MatchMenu').visible
steps.msg: Restart: the same offline match from its start
a click on a creep selects it
Esc with a creep selected drops the selection, as with a tower
a right click drops it too
with nothing selected, Esc opens the menu
Leave to hub: back in the hub, offline
